import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 200;
    static final int MAXM = 100000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;
    static int[][] ma = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, N, t;
    static String s;
    static int[][] hu = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int[][] re = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int cx, cy;
    static int[][] stran = {{0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0}};
    static int[] dis = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] qu = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] d = new int[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;
    static int[] stk = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];

    static class Edge {
        int st, ed, flow, next;

        Edge(int st, int ed, int flow, int next) {
            this.st = st;
            this.ed = ed;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        cx = 0;
        cy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ma[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mat[i], -1);
        }
        zr = -1;
        zc = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    ma[i][j + 1] = -1;
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i;
                    zc = j + 1;
                    ma[i][j + 1] = -1;
                } else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cx++;
                    hu[cx][0] = i;
                    hu[cx][1] = j + 1;
                    hu[cx][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cy++;
                    re[cy][0] = i;
                    re[cy][1] = j + 1;
                    re[cy][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve());
    }

    static int isok(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && ma[r][c] != -1) {
            return (r - 1) * n + c;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static void BG() {
        N = n * n;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mat[i], -1);
        }
        for (int r1 = 1; r1 <= n; r1++) {
            for (int c1 = 1; c1 <= n; c1++) {
                if (ma[r1][c1] == -1) continue;
                int p1 = (r1 - 1) * n + c1;
                mat[p1][p1] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int r2 = r1 + stran[i][0];
                    int c2 = c1 + stran[i][1];
                    if (r2 > 0 && r2 <= n && c2 > 0 && c2 <= n && ma[r2][c2] != -1) {
                        int p2 = (r2 - 1) * n + c2;
                        mat[p1][p2] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Floyd() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                for (int z = 1; z <= N; z++) {
                    if (mat[j][i] != -1 && mat[i][z] != -1) {
                        if (mat[j][z] == -1 || mat[j][z] > mat[j][i] + mat[i][z]) {
                            mat[j][z] = mat[j][i] + mat[i][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edges.add(new Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st]));
        head[st] = E++;
        edges.add(new Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed]));
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    static void BF() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            addEdge(src, i, hu[i][2]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= cy; i++) {
            addEdge(cx + i, dest, re[i][2]);
        }
        int dd = (zr - 1) * n + zc;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= cy; j++) {
                int p1 = (hu[i][0] - 1) * n + hu[i][1];
                int p2 = (re[j][0] - 1) * n + re[j][1];
                if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]) {
                    addEdge(i, cx + j, INF);
                } else if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                        int rr = re[j][0] + stran[z][0];
                        int cc = re[j][1] + stran[z][1];
                        int pp = isok(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (mat[p1][pp] == mat[p1][p2] - 1 && mat[p1][pp] < dis[pp]) {
                                addEdge(i, cx + j, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean dinic_bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        queue.offer(src);
        d[src] = 0;
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int now = queue.poll();
            for (int i = head[now]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                int ed = edges.get(i).ed;
                if (d[ed] == -1 && edges.get(i).flow > 0) {
                    d[ed] = d[now] + 1;
                    if (ed == dest) return true;
                    queue.offer(ed);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0;
        while (dinic_bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
                cur[i] = head[i];
            }
            int u = src;
            int top = 0;
            while (true) {
                if (u == dest) {
                    int minf = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
                        if (edges.get(stk[i]).flow < minf) minf = edges.get(stk[i]).flow;
                    }
                    ret += minf;
                    for (int i = 0; i < top; i++) {
                        Edge e = edges.get(stk[i]);
                        e.flow -= minf;
                        edges.get(stk[i] ^ 1).flow += minf;
                        if (e.flow == 0) top = i;
                    }
                    u = edges.get(stk[top]).st;
                } else {
                    boolean advanced = false;
                    for (int i = cur[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                        Edge e = edges.get(i);
                        if (e.flow > 0 && d[e.ed] == d[u] + 1) {
                            stk[top++] = i;
                            u = e.ed;
                            advanced = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        cur[u] = i;
                    }
                    if (!advanced) {
                        if (--d[u] == -1) break;
                        if (top > 0) u = edges.get(stk[--top]).st;
                        else break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int solve() {
        ma[zr][zc] = 0;
        BG();
        spfa();
        ma[zr][zc] = -1;
        BG();
        Floyd();
        BF();
        int ret = dinic();
        return ret;
    }

    static void spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        int dd = (zr - 1) * n + zc;
        dis[dd] = 0;
        int fr = 0, re = 1;
        qu[0] = dd;
        while (fr < re) {
            int now = qu[fr++];
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                if (mat[now][i] != -1 && dis[i] > dis[now] + 1) {
                    dis[i] = dis[now] + 1;
                    qu[re++] = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
